title: Longitudinal Monitoring of LLM Content Moderation of Social Issues
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion in Society, Ethics, and Politics' and 'Religious Traditions and Denominations' as major categories in its social issues dataset used to audit LLMs. It specifically measures and analyzes refusal rates for content related to various faiths (e.g., Islam, Buddhism, Christianity) and ethical/moral issues like abortion and political animosity.
